text:
Emma Chen: Quick kickoff — launching the webinar paid push next Wed. Need search + retarget setup, creative refresh, and budget pacing rules. Who can own which pieces?
Dave R: I can take search setup. What are our target CPA and geo?
Emma Chen: Target CPA $45. Primary: US + CA + UK. Secondary: AU. Start split 60% search / 30% retarget / 10% display as starter allocation.
Maria Gomez: I’ll own the retarget creative refresh. Can someone pull last 30d top-converting CTAs and creative IDs? Need them to build 3 new variants (2 images + 1 short vid).
Leo Park: For pacing, recommend dayparting: +15% bids 9am-12pm ET, -30% bids 10pm-6am ET. Also enable budget smoothing (cap daily +/-20%) so we don’t overspend early.
ads-bot: UTM template ready: ```?utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=webinar_may&utm_content={{adgroup}}&utm_term={{keyword}}&utm_id={{campaignid}}```
Dave R: Plan for search: exact + phrase + broad-mod by intent, 3 ad groups (high-intent branded, intent, competitors). Daily campaign budget $1,500 to start (will scale based on CPA).
Maria Gomez: For retargeting: frequency cap 3 ads/day, creative rotation algorithmic, 15s video + 2 static cards for dynamic creative. I’ll A/B headlines: "Secure your spot" vs "Live: Hands-on infra for inference".
Emma Chen: Inbound routing — want leads to flow: MQL -> Sales queue (round-robin) + webhook to marketing-ops slack channel + Server-to-server to SFDC. Also include "source=paid_search" field.
Dave R: I’ll implement gclid passthrough and server-side postback to Braze for attribution. Also will tag events: lead_submit, webinar_reg, utm_campaign.
Leo Park: Don’t forget to set a canary adset (5% spend) with new creatives for the first 48h to monitor CPAs and click-through. If CPA > $60, auto-pause and route spend to baseline creative.
Maria Gomez: Will share creative variants and sizes by EOD. Also propose a short 15s testimonial clip for retargeting.
Emma Chen: Awesome. Can we all sync tomorrow 10am PST for initial rollout checklist? Adding action owners: Dave (search), Maria (retarget creatives + ad ops), Leo (pacing + throttles), Emma (tracking & routing). :rocket:
Dave R: Sounds good. I’ll push initial campaigns and share draft naming conventions in the channel when done.
Maria Gomez: +1 — will upload to the creative drive and ping here.
Leo Park: I’ll add pacing rules to the campaign config and set alerts if daily spend deviates >15%.
Emma Chen: Perfect — thanks team.
_meta: This document is a Slack thread (single continuous string) representing a marketing ops discussion about paid campaign setup: search, retargeting creative refresh, budget pacing, and inbound lead routing. Messages are short and in chronological order.
